scripts.setup: if [ ! -e .env.local ] && [ -n "${CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH:-}" ] && [ -e "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/.env.local" ]; then ln -s "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/.env.local" .env.local; fi; for target in backend/.env frontend/.env; do if [ -e "$target" ] && [ ! -L "$target" ]; then echo "Refusing to overwrite non-symlink $target"; exit 1; fi; ln -sfn ../.env.local "$target"; done
